messages:
zoe: flagging a flaky behavior during citrine-lite int8 onboarding on staging. mixed-script prompts (ja + zh + small arabic fragment) sometimes produce broken detok (extra '##' style subtokens) and occasional RTL bracket reversal. reproducible on ~10/200 eval samples.
arjun: can you drop a short repro and metric delta?
zoe: repro prompt: "今日はいい天気。翻訳成中文：今天是个好天气。 also arabic: (مرحبا)"
zoe: fp16 baseline -> bleu 32.1, chrF 0.56. q8f -> bleu 27.0, chrF 0.47. failures concentrated in mixed-script subset.
yuki: quick check: is tokenizer/vocab consistent? sometimes merges reorder on export.
zoe: pinned tokenizer v2.2 in model card, export logs show same vocab sha. ran detok locally -> mismatch only when running on runtime q8 path.
arjun: any runtime warnings?
zoe: found runtime warn: "kv_cache: write overflow on shard 2 at step 62" and later "pop index mismatch".
yuki: that smells like cache write path perturbation. does disabling continuous batching or prefix cache change repro?
zoe: yep — turning off cont-batching removes the extra subtokens in quick smoke.
arjun: so cont-batching + q8 kernel interaction. bench-bot: scheduled microbench to compare q8 backends (v1,v2) and q4 variants. job id: 2026-03-21_mb_443.
yuki: plan: 1) reproduce with dump of kv state around switch point (zoe) 2) run kernel bisect for q8 backends (arjun) 3) audit serialization of kv for mixed script boundaries (infra) 4) short-term: disable cont-batching for _q8 models on mixed-script locale routing (product infra flag).
eo-ops: infra-bot suggests adding a per-route override in runtime config: if request.locale matches /mixed/ or contains multi-script tag then set cont_batch=false for quantized runtimes.
zoe: I'll open triage issue with failing samples, kv dumps, eval tarball and link here. attaching small kv excerpt: 
```nstep 61: kv_len 61 (fp16)
step 61: kv_len 62 (q8f)

fp16 tokens around boundary: [2048, 5091] -> ['今日', 'は']
q8f tokens around boundary: [2048, 99, 5091] -> ['今日', '##', 'は']
```
arjun: thanks. if kv len increments only during script-change boundary that's our trigger. I'll start kernel bisect and try running q8 with different quant params (--q_dtype symmetric vs asymmetric, --quant-bias-clip)
yuki: also verify detok post-processing: are we normalizing ZWJ/ZWNJ positions differently in q8 path? could be off-by-one when re-assembling grapheme clusters.
eval-bot: rerunning multilang-detok-suite against citrine-lite_q8 on staging with cont-batching off to compare. job 2026-03-21_eval_77 queued.
zoe: temporary mitigation deployed: runtime rule to disable cont-batching for models tagged `_q8` on locales ["multiscript","ja-zh-mixed"]. will monitor.
arjun: great. once kernel bisect narrows to commit range we'll open a deeper issue for kernel-team.
yuki: ping me when you have dumps, I'll help with detok replays.
zoe: thanks all, will post issue + sample link shortly. :thumbsup:
